business_filings.summary: No +10% onset in the 18 months before the 1990-91 or 2001 recessions: two came just after each ended (1992-01, 2002-01), one years early (1986-01) - 3 false alarms in 33 scored years.

consumer_filings.summary: Rising from 1985 through 1990-91 with no fresh warning (its Jan-1986 onset is a false alarm); the 2001 rise was published Jan-2002, after the recession ended (missed). 3 false alarms (1986, 1996, 2002); tested on annual data.

failure_liabilities.summary: D&B liabilities of failing firms led reliably only as turning points: a +25%-growth alert fired late at 8 of 10 peaks in 1896-1938 and at both clean peaks out of sample in 1967-83 (after the 1969 and 1973 recessions began; missed 1980 and 1981); it led once (1957, by 8 months) in the 1948-66 context run. Liabilities bottomed 8-31 months before the 1957-80 peaks, dated after the fact - too long and erratic to time.

states.summary: A state's filing growth predicted its own next-year job losses mainly in the 1980s (1981-90; with the pre-registered claims control, 1988-2000, none is significant at 5% - the job-loss tests are borderline, p 0.055 / 0.062). Since 2002 the only hit is business filings -> job losses (p 0.047), the out-of-sample check is uninformative, and a state's rising unemployment predicts its later filings. Business Ch 7 filings move with the state's unemployment over the same year (confirm, p 0.046); consumer filings show no evidence of a lead.

CORALACBS.label: All loans - charge-offs
CORALACBS.variant_note: on point-in-time year-on-year growth (not the pre-registered 4-quarter average) it led all 3 scored recessions (5, 1 and 7 months) with 3 false alarms (1988, 1995, 2019); raw size p 0.038, about 0.23 after Holm across the nine

bottoms.grade: tested 'confirms the trough': fails (5 of 16, needs 11)
bottoms.summary: Tested on 16 recessions 1895-1961 (D&B failures): failure growth turns at about the economic bottom (6-month sums, median +0 months) - after the stock market had already bottomed (a median 8 months earlier). A rule that confirms the slowing fired in 7, 5 of them 0-9 months after the trough (2 early), and in none at a recession stock low (0 of 13). The tested grade fails; a post-hoc variant (not graded) fires more often with the same timing. Jobless claims mark troughs sooner.

record.headline: No bankruptcy or credit-distress series passed the pre-registered test as a recession warning. Filings do not lead recessions (they rose with them or after); state business Ch 7 filings move with state unemployment; all-loan charge-offs confirm.
